messages:
Maya Patel: heads up re: NimbleCart onboarding health. p90 latency creeping up ~30ms last 2 weeks, token spend +22%. AM flagged renewal watch if we don’t show cost/latency plan. proposing a two-pronged proactive play: 1) targeted int8 canary on low-risk intents, 2) model hop to compact family for chat-summary path with dynamic routing based on intent classifier. thoughts?
Jordan Lee: agree on canary. suggest we split intents: payments/search/checkout as high-sensitivity (no quant), receipts/summaries/faq as candidates. capture auto-eval with micro-MMR and 1k-sample embedding stability check.
Connor Ng: for the model hop, recommend goliath-1.7-compact instead of full goliath-2.0 for summary flows — latency delta looks ~18% lower in lab. but watch for hallucination on long receipts. propose routing weight ramp + fallback to goliath-2.0 on low similarity.
Maya Patel: good call. ops ask: what are the rollback thresholds? we should codify them in the canary runbook.
Jordan Lee: rollback rules: answer_similarity_drop > 2.5% OR user-facing error rate up >0.5% OR p95 latency regress >10% -> immediate rollback. logging point: capture both token-level cost and embedding cosine similarity per eval.
Connor Ng: I'll own the warmup plan for dedicated pool and prefetch top N prefixes. plan: pre-warm 15 minutes before traffic shift, run synthetic ramp generator for 10 mins. Also add KV-prefetch for last-mile session tokens.
Maya Patel: can someone draft a compact canary config and eval set? include 3 quality checks: BLEU-ish for receipts, paraphrase recall for FAQ, and perceived quality survey for 40 queries.
Jordan Lee: here's a small canary snippet you can reuse:
```yaml
canary_run:
  name: nimblecart-compact-int8-canary
  model_candidates: [goliath-1.7-compact-int8, goliath-1.7-compact-awq]
  traffic_schedule: [0.02, 0.1, 0.25]
  eval_set: ["receipt_extract_small","faq_short","summary_medium"]
  metrics: [p95_latency, token_cost_pct, answer_similarity_cosine, user_error_rate]
  rollback_criteria: ["answer_similarity_cosine_drop>0.025","user_error_rate_increase>0.005","p95_latency_increase>0.10"]
```
Maya Patel: great. I’ll draft the customer enablement note with conservative savings estimate (6-10%) and explicit rollback steps. include a slide for renewal meeting.
Connor Ng: I'll wire the routing policy in the staging gate and add canary alerts to CS healthboard. also setting an ops-bot rule to page if p95 > baseline + 15ms during ramp.
cs-bot: reminder set: NimbleCart_canary_check at 1769392400. create incident if rollback criteria met.
Jordan Lee: one more: capture a small human eval of 40 items across intents for perceived regression. I can recruit reviewers.
Maya Patel: assigning: @Jordan prepare eval sets + human rubric, @Connor implement warmup + routing, @Maya prepare enablement + renewal slide. update CS health dashboard by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Connor Ng: ack.
Jordan Lee: on it.
